notes: Exalted: The Sidereals reviewed cover-to-cover for Chapters One through Six, plus the cross-splat supplements Savant and Sorcerer and Book of Three Circles fully triaged for Sidereal scope. 472 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/sidereal/inventory/. Core book (252 rows): the character-creation overview (including the Ronin variant), the five Auspicious-Ability groups and Celestial Hierarchy minimums, the universal Anima Effect, all five Castes, the Arcane Fate signature trait mechanic and its Sidereal Anima Banner visibility/Paradox table, the Craft (Fate) Ability specialty, the altered/new Backgrounds, Chapter Five's general Charm framework, all 25 of Chapter Five's Caste-and-Ability Charm trees in full across all five Castes (152 Charms total), all three of the book's named secret Martial Arts styles (Charcoal March of Spiders, Prismatic Arrangement of Creation, Citrine Poxes of Contagion), the full Sidereal Astrology system (rules framework, Resplendent Destinies, and the complete named-College catalog closing Chapter Six: the Houses of Journeys/Leisure/War/Secrets/Endings and the five Greater Signs), and cross-referenced sorcery spells/a Specialized Prayer. Merits/Flaws confirmed genuinely absent from this book (re-verified via the full alphabetical index). Chapter Seven onward (Storytelling/setting material) is out of scope. Savant and Sorcerer + Book of Three Circles (220 more rows): the complete Chapter Five Terrestrial/Celestial Circle spell catalog (84 selectable spells), a 102-entry Hearthstone catalog (15 from Savant and Sorcerer plus 87 from Book of Three Circles' Chapter Six 'long roll,' since Savant and Sorcerer does not reprint it), a 13-row Artifice and Enchantment catalog (rules framework rows, two named Merits, a Magical Materials reference, and 5 selectable Sample Artifacts), a 13-row Warstriders appendix (rules framework, all five warstrider design classes as selectable equipment, weapon-catalog references, and the Proteus Gauntlet artifact), and an 8-row skim of Chapter One (Magical Theory) and Chapter Four (Practical Summonings) yielding only gm-only/reference-only content. Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. Locked pending schema/rules/creator/editor implementation and passing tests across all five planned families.
